shortDescription: Use NIM to update a single or a pair of Virtual I/O Servers.

options.name: accept_licenses
options.description: Specifies whether the software licenses should be automatically accepted during the installation.

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the action to perform. C(install) installs new and supported filesets. C(commit) commits all uncommitted updates. C(cleanup) removes all incomplete pieces of the previous installation. C(remove) removes the listed filesets from the system in C(filesets) or C(installp_bundle).

options.name: filesets
options.description: Specifies a list of file sets to remove from the targets. Can be used with I(action=remove).

options.name: installp_bundle
options.description: Specifies an I(installp_bundle) resource that lists filesets to remove on the targets. Can be used with I(action=remove).

options.name: lpp_source
options.description: Specifies the NIM I(lpp_source) resource that will provide the installation images for the operation.

options.name: manage_cluster
options.description: Specifies whether the cluster should be check and stop before updating the vios and restarted after the update.

options.name: nim_node
options.description: Allows to pass along NIM node info from a task to another so that it discovers NIM info only one time for all tasks.

options.name: preview
options.description: Specifies to run the operations in preview operation. No action is actually performed.

options.name: targets
options.description: Specifies the list of VIOSes NIM targets tuple to update. You can specify a list of a VIOS to update alone, or two VIOSes to update as a couple.

options.name: time_limit
options.description: Before starting the action on a VIOS tuple, the actual date is compared to this parameter value; if it is greater then the task is stopped. The format is C(mm/dd/yyyy hh:mm). The resulting status for tuples in this case will be I(SKIPPED-TIMEOUT).

options.name: vios_status
options.description: Specifies the result of a previous operation. If set then the I(vios_status) of a target tuple must contain C(SUCCESS) to attempt update. If no I(vios_status) value is found for a tuple, then returned I(status) for this tuple is set to C(SKIPPED-NO-PREV-STATUS).
